lines.zh: 我踩着河岸的泥，一步三摇地巡自己的地界。
lines.en: I tramp the riverbank mud, swaying as I patrol my own ground.

lines.zh: 四条腿压得很低，尾巴替我保持平衡。
lines.en: I keep low on four legs, my tail balancing every stride.

lines.zh: 这片林子归我，我只是走走看看。
lines.en: This woodland is mine; I am only taking a walk to check it.

lines.zh: 我沿着兽径往前走，鼻尖一直贴着地面。
lines.en: I follow the game trail, nose pressed to the dirt.

lines.zh: 脚爪陷进湿土，我拔出一步再迈下一步。
lines.en: My claws sink in damp soil; I pull one free and step again.

lines.zh: 我绕开密林，专挑开阔的坡地走。
lines.en: I skirt the thick trees and keep to the open slope.

lines.zh: 每走几步我就停下，听远处有没有脚步。
lines.en: Every few steps I halt and listen for distant footfalls.

lines.zh: 我的步子不算快，可每一下都落得很沉。
lines.en: My pace is not fast, but every footfall lands heavy.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙走路从不藏，地上全是我的印子。
lines.en: I do not hide my walking; my prints mark the ground.

lines.zh: 我在水边来回走，水面映出我的鼻角。
lines.en: I pace the water's edge, my nose horn mirrored below.

lines.zh: 我蹭过灌木，把身上的泥刮掉。
lines.en: I brush past the shrubs to scrape the mud off my flank.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴穿过蕨丛，叶子一路抖。
lines.en: My tail drags through the ferns, shaking leaves all the way.

lines.zh: 我走向气味最浓的地方，那里也许有吃的。
lines.en: I head for the strongest smell; there may be food there.

lines.zh: 走这条路没有别的意思，我只是在巡视。
lines.en: Walking this way means nothing more than a patrol.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，只让风从鼻子灌进肺里。
lines.en: I stand still, letting wind pour through my nostrils.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙的角不是摆设，我抬头让人看见。
lines.en: My horn is no ornament; I lift my head to be seen.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，听着林子里细碎的声响。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the small sounds in the trees.

lines.zh: 那只异特龙要是敢来，我就在这儿等它。
lines.en: If that Allosaurus dares come, I will wait right here.

lines.zh: 我把重心换到另一条腿上，歇一歇。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other leg and rest.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，太阳把我的鳞照得发亮。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes; the sun makes my hide gleam.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，假装自己是一段倒下的木头。
lines.en: I hold utterly still, pretending to be a fallen log.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声低响，那只是习惯。
lines.en: A low sound rolls in my throat; it is only habit.

lines.zh: 我盯着地上那道旧爪痕，那是我的。
lines.en: I stare at the old claw mark in the dirt; it is mine.

lines.zh: 风停了，连虫子的动静都听得清。
lines.en: The wind dies and I can hear even the insects.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，让鼻角对着前方。
lines.en: I lower my head so my nose horn points ahead.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己活了多少年，只记得我很重。
lines.en: I cannot count my years, only how heavy I am.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不必着急的时机。
lines.en: I am waiting for a moment that need not be hurried.

lines.zh: 这片地安静得让我懒得多走一步。
lines.en: This ground is quiet enough to make me lazy.

lines.zh: 我转过身看你，四根指头的爪子扣进土里。
lines.en: I turn to face you, my four-fingered claws digging in.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我眼睛不离开你。
lines.en: You stand too close; I do not take my eyes off you.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子闻你，判断你值不值得追。
lines.en: I raise my snout to scent you, judging if you are worth a chase.

lines.zh: 我歪着头打量你，你的个头让我犹豫。
lines.en: I cock my head at you; your size makes me hesitate.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让你看看我的牙有多长。
lines.en: I open my jaws to show you how long my teeth are.

lines.zh: 我把鼻角对准你，这算是警告。
lines.en: I aim my nose horn at you; that is a warning.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道很陌生，我要记住。
lines.en: Your smell is unfamiliar; I mean to remember it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧身，把最厚的背对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, presenting my thickest flank to you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，一下都不眨。
lines.en: I hold your eyes and do not blink once.

lines.zh: 你又动了一下，我把头压得更低。
lines.en: You move again, and I press my head lower.

lines.zh: 我在判断你算猎物还是对手。
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are prey or a rival.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，看你退不退。
lines.en: I step forward half a pace to see whether you retreat.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，往旁边跳开。
lines.en: I grunt once and spring aside.

lines.zh: 疼得我直甩头，牙都露出来了。
lines.en: The pain makes me shake my head, teeth bared.

lines.zh: 我低下头护住肋侧。
lines.en: I duck my head to guard my ribs.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，又硬撑着站住。
lines.en: I give half a step, then force myself to stand.

lines.zh: 这一下让我真的火大了。
lines.en: That one genuinely made me angry.

lines.zh: 我的皮在抖，不是因为冷。
lines.en: My hide shivers, and not from cold.

lines.zh: 我咽下那口气，喉咙发紧。
lines.en: I swallow the breath; my throat tightens.

lines.zh: 我对着伤口喷气，血味更浓了。
lines.en: I snort at the wound; the smell of blood sharpens.

lines.zh: 我转身找你，谁干的我要看清。
lines.en: I turn to find you; I want to see who did that.

lines.zh: 我拖着腿走开两步，才敢回头看。
lines.en: I drag myself two steps away before I dare look back.

lines.zh: 那味道是肉，我的舌头先动了。
lines.en: That smell is meat; my tongue moves before I do.

lines.zh: 我朝你手上走，脚步比刚才快。
lines.en: I walk toward what you hold, faster than before.

lines.zh: 生肉的气味压过了我所有警觉。
lines.en: The smell of raw meat drowns out all my caution.

lines.zh: 我不看你了，我只盯着那块肉。
lines.en: I no longer look at you, only at the meat.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，把鼻子伸过去闻。
lines.en: I lower my neck and reach my snout toward it.

lines.zh: 这香味让我忘了刚才在守着什么。
lines.en: This scent makes me forget what I was guarding.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出讨要的声响，我自己都听见了。
lines.en: A begging rumble rises in my throat; even I hear it.

lines.zh: 你要是不松手，我就自己来拿。
lines.en: If you do not let go, I will simply take it.

lines.zh: 我一步一停地靠近，怕你反悔。
lines.en: I close in a step at a time, afraid you will change your mind.

lines.zh: 为这一口，我可以暂时容忍你站着。
lines.en: For this one bite I can tolerate you standing there.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肋侧，硬得像撞石头。
lines.en: You bump my ribs; they are hard as stone.

lines.zh: 我一个甩身，把你顶开半步。
lines.en: I swing my body and shove you back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了方向，立刻拧回来。
lines.en: The knock turns me aside; I twist right back.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你，那不是我故意的。
lines.en: My tail sweeps across you; that was not deliberate.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我会当成挑衅。
lines.en: Do not press this close; I read it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 我肩头一沉，把你挤到一边。
lines.en: I drop my shoulder and crowd you aside.

lines.zh: 这一下反倒让我站稳了脚。
lines.en: That knock actually planted my feet.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，把身体横过来挡路。
lines.en: I growl low and turn broadside across the path.

lines.zh: 你撞得我鼻角晃了一下。
lines.en: The hit jolts my nose horn.

lines.zh: 我退半步，又重新压回来。
lines.en: I give half a step, then press back in.

lines.zh: 我压低嗓子叫，叫给林子另一头听。
lines.en: I call low, for the far side of the trees to hear.

lines.zh: 这些日子里，我连猎物都懒得看。
lines.en: In days like these I cannot be bothered with prey.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子走，把气味留在草上。
lines.en: I circle about, leaving my scent on the grass.

lines.zh: 我们相互蹭过颈侧，力气很轻。
lines.en: We brush necks, with a surprising gentleness.

lines.zh: 我用鼻角轻轻顶了顶它。
lines.en: I nudge the other gently with my nose horn.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴摆得比平时慢。
lines.en: My tail swings slower than usual.

lines.zh: 领地的事，这几天可以先放一放。
lines.en: Territory can wait for a few days.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，谁也没走开。
lines.en: We stand flank to flank, neither walking away.

lines.zh: 等这一阵过去，我又要回去巡界。
lines.en: When this passes, I will go back to patrolling.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的咕噜声，只给它听。
lines.en: I make a soft rumble meant for it alone.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起那块肉，一口就没了。
lines.en: I dip my head and snatch up the meat; it is gone in a bite.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住，怕被抢走。
lines.en: I pin it down with a foreclaw so nothing steals it.

lines.zh: 四根指头抓得挺牢，我拖到树后吃。
lines.en: My four fingers grip well; I drag it behind a tree to eat.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，这东西不能吃，扔下。
lines.en: I sniff; this is not food, so I drop it.

lines.zh: 我把骨头叼走，藏进蕨丛里。
lines.en: I carry the bone off and hide it in the ferns.

lines.zh: 我叼起来转身就走，不打算分享。
lines.en: I pick it up and turn away; I do not intend to share.

lines.zh: 这块太硬，我咬了两下才咬住。
lines.en: This one is too tough; it takes two tries to grip.

lines.zh: 我把它甩到背上，它又滑了下来。
lines.en: I toss it onto my back; it slides right off.

lines.zh: 我占住这个东西，谁靠近我就吼。
lines.en: I claim this thing, and growl at anyone drawing near.

lines.zh: 进了嘴的东西，我不会再松口。
lines.en: What reaches my jaws, I do not release.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，脚已经朝这边偏。
lines.en: I have locked on you, and my feet already angle this way.

lines.zh: 鼻子里那股气味，我认准了。
lines.en: That scent in my nostrils is the one I want.

lines.zh: 我突然不走了，把身子压低。
lines.en: I stop short and sink lower to the ground.

lines.zh: 尾巴绷直，我知道要开始了。
lines.en: My tail goes stiff; I know what is starting.

lines.zh: 你动的那一下，让我下了决心。
lines.en: That one movement of yours made up my mind.

lines.zh: 我不再犹豫，喉咙里滚出声响。
lines.en: No more hesitating; a growl rolls from my throat.

lines.zh: 我选了你，因为你落在最后。
lines.en: I choose you because you lag behind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头对准你的方向。
lines.en: I line my head up with you, slowly.

lines.zh: 空气里的味道变了，我闻到了怕。
lines.en: The air tastes different; I smell fear.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里出来，不再藏着。
lines.en: I step out of the shade; no more hiding.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一根枯枝，故意让你听见。
lines.en: I snap a dry branch, letting you hear it.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别的目标，只有你。
lines.en: There is no other target here but you.

lines.zh: 我压着步子靠近，先不惊动你。
lines.en: I creep closer, not spooking you yet.

lines.zh: 角朝前，剩下的交给牙。
lines.en: My horn leads; my teeth do the rest.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，一步都不落。
lines.en: I follow you, never losing a step.

lines.zh: 你转弯，我也转弯，鼻子没离开你。
lines.en: You turn; I turn, nose never leaving you.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我不停。
lines.en: I do not move fast, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 树挡了一下，我撞开它继续走。
lines.en: A tree blocks me; I shove through and keep coming.

lines.zh: 你跑得再远，味道还留在空气里。
lines.en: Run far as you like; your scent stays in the air.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的后背，等的就是这一下。
lines.en: I watch your back; this is the moment I waited for.

lines.zh: 爪子往前面刨土，我随时能扑。
lines.en: My claws tear the soil; I can spring at any moment.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，那里的路更短。
lines.en: I cut to your flank; the path is shorter there.

lines.zh: 河不深，我直接蹚过去追。
lines.en: The river is shallow; I wade straight across after you.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸粗了，脚步却没乱。
lines.en: My breathing roughens, but my stride stays steady.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就让你看见我还在。
lines.en: Look back and you will see I am still here.

lines.zh: 我不管那只异特龙了，先解决你。
lines.en: I forget the Allosaurus; you come first.

lines.zh: 距离一点一点缩短，我很清楚。
lines.en: The gap closes bit by bit, and I know it.

lines.zh: 这段追逐里，我从没想过放弃。
lines.en: In this chase I have never once thought of quitting.

lines.zh: 你退到角落里，那我就慢慢来。
lines.en: Backed into a corner? Then I will take my time.

lines.zh: 我张嘴就咬，牙全都扎进去。
lines.en: I open wide and bite; every tooth sinks in.

lines.zh: 前爪拍下去，把你按在地上。
lines.en: My foreclaw slams down and pins you.

lines.zh: 我用鼻角顶，把你顶得倒退。
lines.en: I drive with my nose horn and knock you back.

lines.zh: 这一甩头，撕开一道口子。
lines.en: One shake of my head opens a gash.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，整个身体都是武器。
lines.en: I charge; my whole body is the weapon.

lines.zh: 我咬住不松，等你不再挣。
lines.en: I bite and hold until you stop struggling.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过来，声音很闷。
lines.en: My tail whips around with a dull crack.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的腿，再低下头。
lines.en: I plant a foot on your leg, then lower my head.

lines.zh: 牙在骨头上滑了一下，我又咬紧。
lines.en: My teeth slip on bone; I clamp down harder.

lines.zh: 我侧身一扑，压在你身上。
lines.en: I lunge sideways and come down on you.

lines.zh: 这下是给你的，别怪我没警告。
lines.en: This one is for you; I did warn you.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退开，看你还站不站得住。
lines.en: I bite and pull back to see if you can still stand.

lines.zh: 下颚合上，声音很干脆。
lines.en: My jaws close with a clean snap.

lines.zh: 我甩掉嘴角挂着的东西，再上前一步。
lines.en: I shake off what clings to my jaw and step in again.

lines.zh: 河岸的蕨丛被拨开，我走了出来。
lines.en: The riverside ferns part and I step out.

lines.zh: 先出现的是一声低吼，然后才是我的身体。
lines.en: First comes a low roar, then the body.

lines.zh: 我从林线那头慢慢显出身形。
lines.en: I take shape slowly at the far edge of the trees.

lines.zh: 泥土里留下新印子，我来了。
lines.en: Fresh prints press into the soil; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 这片地界多了一股我不认识的气味。
lines.en: A new scent has entered my ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻角，让整片林子看见我。
lines.en: I raise my nose horn to let the woods see me.

lines.zh: 我停在坡上，先看清楚再下去。
lines.en: I stop on the slope to look before going down.

lines.zh: 太阳底下，我身上的鳞反着光。
lines.en: In the sun my hide throws back the light.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根树枝，这算打过招呼。
lines.en: I break a branch; consider that my greeting.

lines.zh: 远处那群异特龙，又多了一个对手。
lines.en: For that band of Allosaurus, there is one more rival now.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，脚下一步不虚。
lines.en: I walk out of the mist, sure of every step.

lines.zh: 这块地方的气味，我要重新盖一遍。
lines.en: I will lay my scent over this ground again.

lines.zh: 我不急，先绕一圈看看谁在这儿。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I circle first to see who is here.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到你脚边，然后才是我。
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first; then I do.

lines.zh: 我站定了，林子里一下安静。
lines.en: I come to a stop, and the woods go quiet.

lines.zh: 这是我头一回踩在这片苔上。
lines.en: This is the first time I tread this moss.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，把热气吐进冷空气里。
lines.en: I open my jaws and breathe heat into the cold air.

lines.zh: 我没来过这儿，先得闻一圈。
lines.en: I have never been here; first I must scent the place.

lines.zh: 火燎得我的皮发亮，我冲进泥里打滚。
lines.en: Fire licks my hide bright; I charge into the mud and roll.

lines.zh: 落地的冲劲从脚底窜到脊背，我几乎跪下去。
lines.en: The landing shock runs from my feet to my spine; I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我拼命甩头上岸。
lines.en: Water pours into my nostrils; I thrash my head and fight for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，耳朵里全是叫声。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; my ears are full of ringing.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的肩，我扭头去咬那支箭。
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder; I twist to bite at the arrow.

lines.zh: 一股凉意钻进骨头，我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: A coldness seeps into my bones and my legs will not answer.

lines.zh: 我饿得腹侧贴背，走两步就得停。
lines.en: Hunger pulls my flanks to my spine; two steps and I stop.

lines.zh: 白光劈下来，我整条尾巴都麻了。
lines.en: White light strikes down and my whole tail goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下忽然空了，我什么也抓不到。
lines.en: The ground is suddenly gone and there is nothing to grip.
